fullTextZH: 你有男朋友或者女朋友吗
fullTextEN: Do you have a boyfriend or girlfriend?
Do you think he/she is cute?

fullTextZH: 还是你觉得他（她）很烦人呢
fullTextEN: Or do you think he/she is very annoying?
Today I want to tell you.
I will tell you four reasons why.
He thinks he is very handsome.

fullTextZH: 他告诉我瑞典人是最帅的
fullTextEN: He told me Swedes are the most handsome.
I asked him if British people are handsome.

fullTextZH: 我问他中国的女孩漂亮吗
fullTextEN: I asked him if Chinese girls are pretty.
Swedish men are the most handsome.
Swedish women are the most beautiful.

fullTextEN: I asked him why he thinks Swedes are handsome.

fullTextZH: 他说因为他们有蓝色的眼睛
fullTextEN: He said because they have blue eyes.

fullTextZH: 他说蓝色的眼睛很漂亮
fullTextEN: He said blue eyes are very beautiful.
Because it's the color of the sea.

fullTextEN: I asked him if my eyes are brown.
I told him poop is brown.

fullTextZH: 我说我喜欢棕色的眼睛
fullTextEN: I said I like brown eyes.

fullTextZH: 第二点是他会说很多语言
fullTextEN: The second point is he can speak many languages.
He can speak too many languages.

fullTextZH: 其实是他会说我不会说的语言
fullTextEN: Actually, he can speak languages I can't speak.

fullTextZH: 他会说英语西班牙语法语和瑞典语
fullTextEN: He can speak English, Spanish, French, and Swedish.
I can speak English and Spanish.

fullTextZH: 可是我的法语和瑞典语不太好
fullTextEN: But my French and Swedish are not very good.

fullTextZH: 他和他的家人在一起的时候
fullTextEN: When he is with his family.

fullTextZH: 因为他知道太多我不会的语言
fullTextEN: Because he knows too many languages I don't.
At first, I was very happy.

fullTextZH: 你可以和我的爸爸妈妈说中文
fullTextEN: You can speak Chinese with my parents.
Great, you need to keep it up.

fullTextZH: 现在他每个星期上中文课
fullTextEN: Now he takes Chinese classes every week.

fullTextZH: 因为他学习一个新的词
fullTextEN: Because he learned a new word.

fullTextZH: 他会跟我说很多很多遍
fullTextEN: He will say it to me many, many times.
I said my name is Zhifei.

fullTextZH: 你是不是也觉得他很烦人
fullTextEN: Do you also think he is annoying?
The fourth annoying thing about him is

fullTextZH: 而且他每天都要我运动
fullTextEN: And he wants me to exercise every day

Right now, I really don't want to exercise.

fullTextEN: The first is he thinks he is very handsome.

fullTextEN: The first time I heard someone say
people from their own country are the most handsome.

fullTextEN: The second is he speaks too many languages I don't know.

fullTextEN: The third is he speaks incorrect Chinese.

fullTextZH: 你的男朋友或者女朋友也很烦人吗
